name: Jaleco SS88006

components.role: SS88006 ASIC with split-nibble PRG/CHR bank registers, work-RAM protection, four-mode CIRAM routing and masked CPU-cycle IRQ counter
Optional external Jaleco sample package on selected boards; mapper control output is represented, sample synthesis is not fitted in v2.45.0

notes: Mapper 18 uses three switchable 8 KiB PRG windows plus a fixed final bank, eight switchable 1 KiB CHR windows, optional 8 KiB work RAM with a two-bit protection latch, H/V/both single-screen mirroring, and a CPU-cycle down-counter whose 4/8/12/16-bit mask is selected by IRQ mode bits. Some Jaleco boards fit an external uPD7755C/uPD7756C sample package; the SS88006 control output is retained as hardware state without inventing sample ROM data or host-side audio semantics.
